description: This file defines the EmployeeEvaluationAPI class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system's Performance module. It provides API endpoints for retrieving and updating employee performance review evaluations within the HR system, including handling review data, reviewer ratings, allowed actions, and validation rules.

classes.name: EmployeeEvaluationAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for employee performance review evaluations, including retrieving review data, updating ratings, and managing workflow actions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve employee evaluation data for a specific review, including ratings, comments, and allowed actions.

methods.name: getReviewerRatings
methods.description: Retrieves reviewer ratings for a specific evaluation based on provided search/filter parameters.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts the number of reviewer ratings matching the search/filter criteria.

methods.name: getReviewerForReviewRating
methods.description: Get reviewer details associated with a review for rating purposes.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Determines and returns the list of allowed workflow actions for a given performance review.

methods.name: getAllowedActionList
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve not allowed, but possible, actions based on current review state and user roles.

methods.name: setReviewRatingsParams
methods.description: Sets and saves review ratings submitted via API request.

methods.name: checkActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether the current user can perform certain workflow actions on the review.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates the reviewer's status (e.g., in progress, completed) based on user actions.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the comment associated with a reviewer's evaluation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating the review evaluation, including ensuring 'complete' parameter is a boolean.
